name: The scanners as a quality-annotated graph (the missing QUALITY sensor of the COMPLEARN loop)
description: Andrew-direct via CTO~A (the holistic front of the tool-check generalization). Makes the comp-tool suite first-class in the estate graph -- the scanners are nodes, their shared substrates are edges, their archetypes are clusters -- and annotates every tool-node with its ASSURANCE verdict, then wires that verdict into the two places the fabric already reserves for it: comp_tool_health's stubbed EFFECTIVE axis and PROMOTE's promotion gate. The result is the quality sensor the loop is missing: it can finally tell a tool that WORKS from one that exits 0 while LYING. KEYSTONE FINDING (source-grounded): comp-tool-health's value signal is mean_outcome_value from the RESULT column (comp_tool_health.py:163,196), and RESULT = _classify_result() = exit-0->PASS (comp_log_auto.py:170) -- so the number meant to say 'this tool is correct' inherits the success-token-bound-to-the-wrong-step fallacy; the one axis that would catch 'does it reach the right answer' (EFFECTIVE) is stubbed None (:136). SMALLEST CHANGE / HIGHEST LEVERAGE: feed the exercised assurance verdict into the effective bool the code already reserves; the moment the wire lands, comp-freshness flips KEEP->FIX on the axis built for it. LOAD-BEARING RULING (CTO~A-owned): assurance is EVIDENCE, written like FEDOBS writes evidence -- Deny-fenced from mutating graph_nodes/edges/cse/tool_activity (PROMOTE alone materializes truth). Reads NFRA_PASSCRAFT (the ToolAudit CSE stream) + the live globgrph Trino federation (Estate x code_heat x tool_activity). Shares the CTO-owned Goodhart gate with NFRA_COMPLEARN sec.5 (one gate, both consumers).
